svg.title: Square-bore flute in E4, box-square-3-E4-590, sheet 1 of 1
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. Square-bore flute in E4, box-square-3-E4-590, sheet 1 of 1: bird layer, bottom plate, mouthpiece cap, plug disc, side wall, top plate. 3mm ply, drawn for a 0.13mm kerf. Finger joints as the trumpet bores cut them: 6mm fingers and spaces, no play, the fit from the kerf. Engraves first. The flue is a fill engrave in two inks, run either or both: red #ff0000 in the bird's underside, magenta #ff00ff in the top over the plug; one alone about 1mm deep, both about 0.5mm each. Blue #0000ff engraves the depression round each finger hole, a greyscale image engrave, Grayscale mode in xTool Creative Space. Set every depth on scrap first. Then the cuts: orange #ff8000 cuts the holes and slots, and black #000000 frees the parts.
